context.why: US1, US2, US3 and US5 built the record, person and organization views, fields and filters in fairdm/contrib/autocomplete. Read them and follow their patterns. This dispatch covers three small stories in order, one commit per task: US6 (T023-T024, data publication: PublicationAutocompleteView over literature.LiteratureItem searching title, authors and DOI with exact DOI first, row from autocomplete/record_option.html showing authors and year with the DOI as an outline badge; PublicationChoiceField; DatasetForm.reference moves to it), US7 (T025-T026, tags: TagAutocompleteView as a model view over taggit Tag offering only tags on records the requester may view, and tags on public records at the public address; TagsField(allow_new=False|True) drawn as chips with a remove button, cleaning to stripped strings, accepting any non-empty tag when allow_new and only tags in use otherwise; TagFilter; KeywordForm.tags moves to TagsField(allow_new=True); the project list's tag filter becomes TagFilter with no way to add; delete TagWidget), US8 (T027-T028, ROR lookup: RorAutocompleteView, an AutocompleteIterablesView over fairdm.contrib.contributors.services.registries.Ror.search, answering 503 on RegistryUnavailable, with the same LimitedAutocompleteMixin limits; RorChoiceField whose clean() accepts a value that is a ROR ID by form via Ror.identifier_in and never calls the registry; the organization form's ROR lookup moves to it; delete RORWidget and widgets/ror.html). Every new view takes LimitedAutocompleteMixin and the throttles. Fake ROR at the network boundary in tests only. Report each story's tasks separately in the completion report; the orchestrator accepts US6, US7 and US8 one by one.
prior_decisions: D1: a field that places a record inside another needs edit; linking needs view; a public list filter offers public records only, to everyone.
D3: visibility rules are taken as they stand (project by visibility; dataset by get_visible on all_objects; sample/measurement by public+published dataset).
D4: a stored link to a record the editor cannot see is kept and shown as a private record without its name.
D12: limits on the pattern of fairdm/api/throttling.py, refused before any query.

D13: design review. django-tomselect rebuilds the validation view as view_class() (lazy_utils.py:107) and with the current page's q/f/e. So: one view subclass per scope (scope is a class attribute), and FairDM fields validate through the view's offered(user, owner=, type=, depends_on=) and never call django-tomselect's clean(). Use django-tomselect's allowed_filter_fields and allowed_ordering_fields, not a custom allow-list.
Upstream gaps are tracked in this repository's issue #554. Put '#554' in the comments of the two django_tomselect templates.
FR-021 (the 'searching is paused' message) is with the maintainer. Do NOT build it and do NOT write a skipped test for it.

acceptance.given_when_then: Publication view: title and author search, exact DOI first, row gives authors and year; the dataset saves the chosen publication.
View and PublicationChoiceField written, DatasetForm.reference moved.

Tag view offers tags in use on records the requester may view by part of their name; a tag used only on a private record is not offered to someone who cannot view it; public address offers only tags on public records; keyword form saves an existing and a new tag and shows tags chosen when reopened; project list tag filter narrows by tags in use and offers no way to add.
View, TagsField, TagFilter written; KeywordForm.tags and the project tag filter moved; TagWidget deleted.

ROR view (Ror.search faked): entries with their country; 503 when ROR does not answer; same limits as record views; organization form saves a chosen ROR ID with Ror.search faked to raise RegistryUnavailable, and saves without one when ROR is down.
View and RorChoiceField written, organization form moved, RORWidget and widgets/ror.html deleted.
